w:r.w:t: Strategy is a set of integrated choices, constrained by capability, validated by evidence, and defended over time.
Anything else is planning, aspiration, or opinion.
If StrategyCore X is used to manage execution, it has failed.
This authority has the power to:
If authority is shared, negotiated, or unclear,
ENTRY CONDITIONS (WHEN THIS FRAMEWORK MAY RUN)
StrategyCore X must be activated if
Effort is high but impact is unclear
If none are true, do not activate this framework.
You must write a single statement that answers:
Must not be an internal effort goal
Must not be vague or inspirational only
“Become the default provider for X in Y segment”
“Achieve category leadership in Z by owning A capability”
If two leaders interpret “winning” differently, redo it.
exactly where you will and will not compete
You must explicitly choose (and exclude) across
If you cannot exclude, you are avoiding strategy
If the arena is so broad that different teams imagine different customers, redo it.
If it sounds like a slogan, it is invalid
Advantages must fit the chosen arena
If the advantage does not logically win in the chosen arena, redo Phase 2 or 3.
If the fit requires excuses or caveats, redo the choices.
“We can learn later” counts as Missing
If a critical capability is Missing, you must either:
Commit explicitly to building the capability (with ownership and deadline)
Strategy that ignores capability reality is fantasy.
Prevent internal systems from killing the strategy.
List policies, systems, or rules that would undermine the strategy:
Approval layers that slow the strategy
If no disablers are removed, the strategy is performative.
Every major choice must have at least one assumption
Strategy without kill conditions becomes stubbornness.
Strategic Authority declares the strategy verbatim
Avoid KPI theater and misaligned measurement.
COMMAND 11 — BUILD THE STRATEGY LOGIC CHAIN
COMMAND 12 — DEFINE METRICS WITH DECISION TRIGGERS
If a metric does not trigger a decision, it does not exist.
Ensure the strategy survives pressure and time.
Strategy may change deliberately, not emotionally.
StrategyCore X is active only if:
Strategy is choosing, excluding, and defending those choices under pressure.
